summary: Roadmap item 5 of dimension32-global-topology: transition data, structure group, invariants and equivalence classes of the kernel bundles ker L_y over the smooth pieces of D_(5,12), starting from the kernel symmetry group, run as a Codex program.

reconciliation.note: Captured context; triage and evidence review pending.

scope: Evidence bundle docs/evidence/a5-kernel-bundles (scripts, result.json, README, ledger) and the program file docs/design/a5-kernel-bundles-program.md; nullity >= 12 orbits first, nullity 8 as stretch. Attachments, global model and uniform structure (items 6-8) stay out of scope.

steps.action: Compute the Lie algebra of the real group K transporting ker L_y, test which directions of G_2(C) x SO(2, C) x C^* lift, and the K-orbit dimensions on each nullity >= 12 orbit.
steps.acceptance: Fails if a direction claimed to lift fails kernel transport at any representative, or a claimed non-lifting direction transports kernels.

receipts.result: kernel_symmetry.py --check passes: constant symmetry algebra g_2 plus four central directions, no boost lift, visible S_3 x Z_2 components; the independent verifier confirms the algebra and the generic orbit dimensions.

Rerun after pooling the Lie-triple commutators and rebinding downstream digests: constant symmetry algebra g_2 plus four central directions, no boost lift, visible S_3 x Z_2 components; the independent verifier confirms the algebra and the generic orbit dimensions.

steps.action: Give kernel frames polynomial or rational in (z, conj z) on each nullity >= 12 orbit with their degeneracy loci.
steps.acceptance: Fails if L_y x != 0 for a frame vector, or the frame loses rank at an orbit point outside the stated locus.

receipts.result: kernel_frames.py --check passes: principal Pfaffian charts cover every nullity >= 12 piece with rational frames degenerating exactly on pf(B_I) = 0.
Rerun after pooling the Lie-triple commutators and rebinding downstream digests: principal Pfaffian charts cover every nullity >= 12 piece with rational frames degenerating exactly on pf(B_I) = 0.

steps.action: Determine pi_1 and the cohomology needed for the invariants of the unit sections of B9, V, VB, V^a_+- and N_+-.
steps.acceptance: Fails if a stated group disagrees with an explicit fibration or homogeneous-space computation.

receipts.result: aligned_orbit_moduli, v_topology_representation and isotropic_orbit_data --check pass: V^a_+- unit section S^13 minus the quadric link, V homotopy equivalent to S^1 times the antipodal mapping torus of S^6, B9 G_2 x open three-ball, VB V_2(R^7) x S^1; the verifier confirms them as arguments with checked inputs.

Rerun after pooling the Lie-triple commutators and rebinding downstream digests: V^a_+- unit section S^13 minus the quadric link, V homotopy equivalent to S^1 times the antipodal mapping torus of S^6, B9 G_2 x open three-ball, VB V_2(R^7) x S^1; the verifier confirms them as arguments with checked inputs.

steps.action: Build an exact atlas of kernel frames over each smooth piece of D_(5,12), verify the cocycle on overlaps and identify the structure group.
steps.acceptance: Fails if a transition function fails the cocycle identity exactly or leaves the stated structure group.

receipts.result: transition_atlas.py --check passes: exact cocycle on Pfaffian overlaps, structure groups U(6), U(8), SU(2) on N_+-.
Rerun after pooling the Lie-triple commutators and rebinding downstream digests: exact cocycle on Pfaffian overlaps, structure groups U(6), U(8), SU(2) on N_+-.

steps.action: Compute characteristic classes and monodromy and decide triviality or identification with named bundles.
steps.acceptance: Fails if an invariant contradicts an explicit global section or frame.

receipts.result: bundle_invariants.py and nullity_sixteen_bundle.py --check pass with conclusions derived from producer records: nullity-twelve complex bundles trivial, N_+- complex bundle C^2 + 3 xi with the order-two K-class, real bundles trivial; the verifier confirms the N_+- branching and K-group.

Rerun after pooling the Lie-triple commutators and rebinding downstream digests: nullity-twelve complex bundles trivial, N_+- complex bundle C^2 + 3 xi with the order-two K-class, real bundles trivial; the verifier confirms the N_+- branching and K-group.

steps.action: Independent verification, critical review and a claim for confirmed results only, through a pull request and the Codex review loop.
steps.acceptance: research_state.py --check and plan_tracker.py check pass and the four pr.yml checks are green on the PR head.

receipts.result: PR 571 at head 6d4e91e: Codex review clean (clean-comment verdict on the head), every thread resolved, the pr.yml checks lint, types, tests and gates green; research_state.py --check and plan_tracker.py check --base origin/main pass.

resolution: Roadmap item 5 of dimension32-global-topology is discharged on the nullity-12 and nullity-16 strata through PR 571: claim a5-kernel-bundles establishes the kernel symmetry algebra, compact-orbit moduli and stabilizer representations on every piece, an exact transition cocycle, and the classes (nullity-twelve complex bundles trivial, the N_+- complex bundle carrying the order-two K-class, real bundles trivial). The nullity-8 strata continue in their own plan.

receipts.result: PR 571 at head 6d4e91e: Codex review clean (clean-comment verdict on the head), every thread resolved, the pr.yml checks lint, types, tests and gates green; research_state.py --check and plan_tracker.py check --base origin/main pass.
